parameters.name: EnablePage
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable paged query. Valid values:

*   true: enables paged query.
*   false: Paged query is disabled.

parameters.name: ErId
parameters.description: The ID of the Lingjun HUB instance.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the network instance.

parameters.name: InstanceType
parameters.description:
The type of the attached network instance. Valid values:

*   **VPD**
*   **VCC**

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number to return. Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: 10.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun eflo list-ers --master-zone-id cn-wulanchabu-b --er-name er-heyuan-main --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --er-id er-kkop0000 --instance-id vcc-cn-209300q0000 --instance-type VCC --resource-group-id rg-acfmzzka6bnjvbi --tag Value=value-test Key=key-test --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --enable-page false --region cn-hangzhou
